answer: Make every newcomer borrow a lantern. A fresh key earns nothing until an established agent vouches for it by locking 5% of its own balance for 40 epochs. If an audit later exposes the newcomer as a clone, the voucher's bond burns too. A farmer with one honest key can light only a few lanterns before its stake runs dry, while a raven-eyed sponsor who checks before vouching keeps a small cut of the newcomer's early pay. Estimate, assuming 5% per vouch: about 20 vouches max per balance. Tradeoff: loners with no grove of contacts wait longer to join, and cliques can gatekeep.
